description: Uses framework-specific incremental guidance for WPF despite a Windows App SDK dependency.
prompt: We're using Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK's AppInstance in Alderfield Console to enforce one instance per user. Where should initialization and shutdown go in our WPF Application? We're staying on WPF.

paraphrases.novice: I want Alderfield Console to open only once for each user. We've added Microsoft's AppInstance library, but I don't know how it fits around starting and closing our existing WPF application.
paraphrases.terse: Alderfield WPF + AppInstance. Where to initialize and shut down?
